background.value: Pure white background required ("بخلفية بيضاء"); cream, gray, or colored backgrounds are rejected ("الخلفيات الكريمية أو الرمادية أو الملونة مرفوضة")

glasses_policy.value: Glasses are completely prohibited in Egyptian passport photos ("النظارات محظورة تماماً في جوازات السفر المصرية")

headwear_policy.value: Hijab is permitted, provided the face is shown fully ("الحجاب مسموح به مع ظهور الوجه كاملاً")

glasses.en: Glasses are completely prohibited in Egyptian passport photos.
glasses.ko: 이집트 여권 사진에서는 안경 착용이 전면 금지됨.
glasses.ja: エジプトのパスポート写真では眼鏡の着用は一切不可。

headwear.en: Hijab is permitted, provided the face is shown fully.
headwear.ko: 히잡은 허용되나, 얼굴 전체가 온전히 드러나야 함.
headwear.ja: ヒジャブの着用は可能だが、顔全体がはっきり見えている必要あり。

direct_fetch_note.note: Direct WebFetch to mfa.gov.eg returned HTTP 403 (bot protection); direct WebFetch to emoves.moi.gov.eg and moi.gov.eg subpages returned connection-refused / access-rejected responses on every attempt (these Egyptian government sites appear to actively block automated fetching). Values above were confirmed via a grounded Arabic-language web search that quoted specific verbatim Arabic text attributed to www.mfa.gov.eg (Egypt's Ministry of Foreign Affairs), the official page titled 'استخراج او تجديد جواز السفر' (Passport issuance/renewal).

head_height.note: A '38mm hair-to-chin' figure and a '4 photos required' figure appeared repeatedly across searches, but were attributed to generic 'Ministry of Interior' framing via commercial photo-vendor aggregator sites (mybiometricphotos.com, visafoto, etc.), not to a specific quoted line on an .eg government domain. Left unverified per the truthfulness gate rather than asserted on secondary-source consensus alone.
